name: Toluca International Airport (Adolfo López Mateos)

runway.v: Longest runway in Mexico, 4.2 km (operator's rounded figure; exact length and width not stated)
runway.quote: Cuenta con la pista de aterrizaje más larga del país (4.2 Km)

notes: IATA TLC and runway from the airport operator's site (aeropuertodetoluca.com.mx, 'Nosotros' page of the TIAS section, no date). The 4.2 km figure is rounded; take exact length from AIP AD 2.12 before a performance-critical trip.
